text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
L-Look, there's something I gotta tell ya! 
Today, I'm... Today, I'm gonna—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I came here ready to beat you at your 
absolute best, Bono!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I thought about what my weapon is, and I 
figured out how I need to run to win."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if I can pull it off 100%, 
but my preparation has been flawless.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Today, I can give it my all. Today's hero 
is gonna be me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...All right. I definitely... definitely 
won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'll fight with everything I've got using 
my own weapons, too!

Amidst the heated declarations of war... 
The curtain rose on the Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen!
